anchors.paper_title: MI-C dataset of the BCI competition WRCC2023
anchors.reason: The candidate is the Harvard Dataverse deposit (DOI 10.7910/DVN/G8FBHH) of the MI-C dataset, the same DOI listed in the dataset README, with matching three-class MI and 2 stroke patients.

anchors.paper_title: MNE-BIDS: Organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format and facilitating their analysis
anchors.paper_venue: The Journal of Open Source Software
anchors.reason: MNE-BIDS is a software tool for organizing electrophysiology data into BIDS, used for dataset conversion, not a paper describing this motor imagery dataset.

anchors.paper_title: EEG-BIDS, an extension to the brain imaging data structure for electroencephalography
anchors.reason: EEG-BIDS is a data-organization standard/specification extension to BIDS, used to format this dataset, not a paper describing the WRCC2023 MI-C data.

metadata.methods_description: Cue-based, offline motor imagery paradigm with three classes (left hand, right hand, feet), 30 trials per class per subject. EEG was recorded with a Neuracle NeuSen W 64-channel wireless system (59 EEG channels used) at 1000 Hz, standard_1005 montage, 50 Hz line frequency. Each 4 s trial is exposed as a separate run.
